sync.title: Screen Sync
sync.subtitle: Mirror on-screen colours onto your keyboard in real time
sync.backend_hint: Automatic: DXGI → Windows Graphics Capture → GDI
sync.region_hint: Analyse a percentage-based part of the screen (independent of resolution and DPI).
sync.letterbox_hint: Bars are only cropped when they stay black; dark scenes are not cropped.
sync.subtitle_guard_hint: Suppresses white/colourless text pixels in the bottom area.
sync.scene_cut_hint: Shortens the transition delay on hard scene changes.
sync.flash_guard_hint: Temporarily disables fast transitions when there are more than 3 hard cuts per second.
sync.sensitivity_hint: Higher values react to smaller colour changes.
sync.transition_speed_hint: How quickly colours reach the new target.
sync.black_level_hint: Pixels darker than this are ignored by colour analysis.
sync.min_diff_hint: During transitions, smaller changes are not sent (the final value is always sent).
sync.update_rate_hint: Maximum keyboard updates per second. Hardware safety limit is 15 Hz.
sync.preview_hint: Downscaled frame kept in memory only; nothing is saved or sent.
sync.backend_info: Method: {backend} · Display: {monitor} · Algorithm: {algo} · Static frames skipped: {static} · Unchanged screen: {nochange}
sync.warn_black: The captured image has been completely black for a while. The content may be DRM-protected (e.g. some streaming apps) or the scene really is dark. Protection is never bypassed.
sync.warn_hdr: HDR is on: Windows converts the captured image to SDR, so colours may look washed out. HDR compensation is enabled (Settings).
sync.warn_monitor: The selected display was not found; using the primary display.
capture_error.unavailable: This capture method is not available on this system: {default}
capture_error.access_lost: Screen capture is temporarily unavailable (lock screen, UAC, resolution change or exclusive fullscreen). Retrying in {retry} s.
capture_error.monitor_gone: The display was disconnected or not found. Retrying in {retry} s.
capture_error.capture_error: Screen capture could not start: {default} (retrying in {retry} s)
capture_error.crash: The screen sync engine stopped unexpectedly; automatic recovery is being attempted.
perf.eco.desc: 6 analyses/s, at most 6 HID updates/s. Lowest resource usage.
perf.balanced.desc: 12 analyses/s, at most 10 HID updates/s. Recommended for everyday use.
perf.responsive.desc: 24 analyses/s, at most 15 HID updates/s. Faster response for games.
algo.dominant.desc: Applies the most dominant visual colour of the screen to all four zones. Black areas and subtitles are ignored.
algo.palette.desc: Picks four perceptually distinct prominent colours from the whole screen (OKLab clustering). Colours do not hop between zones. Recommended for films.
algo.spatial.desc: Splits the screen into four strips from left to right; each zone takes the colour of its strip.
algo.cinematic.desc: Emphasises the characteristic, saturated colours of the scene. Dark scenes stay dark, small strong accents are preserved.
algo.adaptive.desc: Classifies the scene with deterministic rules: dark → cinematic, single colour → dominant, left/right differ → spatial, otherwise → palette.
studio.title: RGB Studio
studio.subtitle: Control the four zones independently
studio.keyboard_hint: Click: select zone · Ctrl/Shift + click: multi-select
effects.title: Effects Studio
effects.subtitle: Hardware-native and software lighting effects
effects.prefer_hw_hint: The effect runs on the keyboard's own MCU; no continuous HID traffic.
effects.note_hw: This effect uses the controller's native animation. The preview here is a simulation; timing on the physical keyboard may differ.
effects.note_sw: This effect is computed by the application and sent with rate-limited HID updates. The preview matches the colours sent.
effects.note_static: Colours are written to the zones as steady colours.
effects.photosensitivity: For photosensitivity, every effect has a cycle of at least 1 s and at least 0.34 s per colour; there is no hard flashing (strobe) effect.
effect.static.desc: Applies your colours to the zones as steady colours (1–4 colours).
effect.breathing.desc: Colours slowly fade out and in; several colours are used in turn.
effect.color_cycle.desc: The whole keyboard smoothly cycles through the colour list.
effect.rainbow.desc: Rainbow colours flow across the zones.
effect.wave.desc: Your colours flow like a wave in the chosen direction.
effect.gradient_flow.desc: A smooth gradient slowly drifts across neighbouring zones.
effect.color_pulse.desc: Gently rising, slowly decaying pulse; never fully dark.
effect.palette_cycle.desc: Your own palette cycles on every zone with a phase offset.
effect.zone_chase.desc: A highlight colour moves smoothly from zone to zone.
effect.cinematic_ambient.desc: Very slow, calm ambient light drifting between warm and cool tones.

preset.cinematic: Cinematic screen sync for films and series: characteristic colours, slow and soft transitions.
preset.gaming: Fast spatial sync for games: the left/right edges of the screen are carried to the keyboard.
preset.cyberpunk: Neon pink, purple, cyan and yellow.
preset.ocean: Slow gradient flow in blue and turquoise tones.
preset.sunset: Sunset gradient from orange to purple.
preset.night: Warm amber at low brightness for the night.
preset.adaptive: Screen sync that picks the algorithm automatically per scene.
preset.custom: A starting profile to edit with your own colours.
hardware.title: Hardware Status
hardware.subtitle: MysticLight MS-1565 controller and HID communication
hardware.colors_hint: The intended colour and the colour confirmed written to the hardware are shown separately.
hardware.no_readback: The protocol for reading the controller's current colours is not verified, so the application does not assume it knows the hardware colours at startup. "Written" only means a successful HID write, not the physical LED colour.
hardware.conflict_infra: Only MSI infrastructure services are running ({apps}); no Mystic Light lighting component detected.
hardware.conflict_steps: If Mystic Light writes to the same controller, your colours may change unexpectedly. Recommended: turn off or uninstall the Mystic Light feature in MSI Center (MSI Center → Features). If you want to stop the service, do it yourself via services.msc. Refletseher never stops, removes or modifies MSI services or drivers.
hardware.safety_text: Only allow-listed HID packets are sent: {allowed}. Writing to persistent memory and other risky commands ({forbidden}) are blocked in the driver layer. Every packet is validated for 64-byte length, zone mask and colour bounds before it is sent. All writes happen on a single thread, rate limited.
hardware.verified_effects: Effect types verified by observation on the real hardware: {effects}.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Application, capture, hardware and automation preferences
settings.restart_hint: The language change applies after restarting the application.
settings.theme_restart: The theme is fully applied after restarting the application.
settings.autostart_hint: Added to the per-user Run key (HKCU\…\Run); no admin rights needed.
settings.autostart_failed: The startup entry could not be updated.
settings.exit_action_hint: The controller's persistent memory is never written; the choice only affects this session.
settings.backend_hint: DXGI has the lowest overhead; try Windows Graphics Capture or GDI if you have problems.
settings.hdr_comp_hint: Increases saturation by 20% for the washed-out SDR-converted image while HDR is on.
settings.privacy: Privacy: captured images are processed only in memory, downscaled. They are never saved to disk or sent over the network. DRM/protected content restrictions are never bypassed.
settings.hw_enabled_hint: When off, the application uses a simulated keyboard and does not access the HID device.
settings.rate_hint: Measured on the real controller to run without stutter up to 15 Hz (~0.6 ms per packet). Default is 10 Hz.
settings.ack_read_hint: The verified original method: feature report 0x01 is read after each write (result ignored).
settings.refresh_hint: 0 = off. If other software changes the colours, the current state is resent at this interval.
settings.performance_hint: Screen sync profiles store their own performance choice.
settings.automation_hint: Switches profiles when conditions occur and returns to the previous profile afterwards. A profile you pick manually takes precedence.
settings.night_hint: The selected profile is applied within the time range.
settings.game_hint: Applies the profile when the foreground window covers the whole screen (browsers and video players excluded).
settings.automation_idle: No rule is active right now
settings.auto_recovery_hint: Crashed threads are restarted at most 5 times per 5 minutes; no endless retry loop.
settings.debug_hint: For troubleshooting; every HID packet is logged.
settings.about_text: Refletseher {version} · independent lighting studio for the MSI Katana 15 HX (MysticLight MS-1565, VID 0x1462 / PID 0x1601). Not affiliated with MSI Center. Only non-persistent, verified commands are sent to the hardware.
